messages:
leo: Quick flag  after yesterday's switch to multipart/mixed for streaming uploads, we've started seeing a cluster of 400s from integrators that still POST NDJSON bodies. This is primarily hitting our hosted ingestion endpoint.
hana: How many clients affected? and are they SDK or raw HTTP?
leo: ~12 tenants in prod, majority are raw HTTP (cURL, some proxy stacks). SDKs were updated last week so they're fine.
omar: Is the validation layer rejecting on content-type mismatch or payload shape?
leo: content-type is application/x-ndjson or text/plain and body is newline-delimited JSON objects. The new parser expects multipart boundaries, so it errors early.
jess: Short-term fix: add an adapter at the ingress that detects NDJSON content types and converts to multipart on-the-fly before handing to the streaming parser. Low-risk and reversible.
omar: Agree but note side-effects: multipart conversion needs to preserve chunk boundaries and any per-chunk metadata (e.g., chunk-id header).
hana: We should also avoid holding the full request in memory. Implementation must be streaming: read line-by-line, wrap each JSON object into a multipart part forwarded downstream.
leo: Proposed constraints:
- adapter enabled via feature flag per-tenant
- accept content-types: application/x-ndjson, application/ndjson, text/x-ndjson
- convert to multipart/mixed with boundary `--compat-boundary` streaming through
- emit metric `compat.ndjson_ingested` with tenant_id and bytes_in
- log a one-time warning per tenant when adapter used: `compat.ndjson.used`

jess: Rollout plan:
1) Deploy adapter to staging and run internal load tests with large NDJSON files (verify memory usage)
2) Canary to 5 affected tenants for 24h (FF ON)
3) If no regressions, open to 50% of edge traffic for 48h
4) After 14 days, send tenant owners migration notice and schedule enforcement window at day 21 where adapter can be toggled OFF for that tenant if migration incomplete

omar: For enforcement, instead of hard reject immediately, return `422` with body explaining: "NDJSON input deprecated; please send multipart/mixed or upgrade SDK. See https://redwood.ai/migration/stream-framing". Also include header `X-Compat-Adapter: used` when we converted.
hana: I'll pair with infra to ensure the adapter is implemented as a non-blocking transform in ingress-worker (<2% P50 added latency). We'll also add an e2e test that streams 10k small objects.
leo: Jess, can you draft the short-run runbook for #release-war-room if memory spikes? If the adapter shows memory issues we'll revert quickly.
jess: Yeah. I'll also add a dashboard: `sum(compat.ndjson_ingested) by tenant / 1d` and an alert if >5MB/s sustained per worker.
ingress-bot: deploy queued: ingress/ndjson-compat-adapter -> canary job/9821
leo: Thanks. We'll keep the adapter active no longer than 21 days per-tenant by default. If any tenant requests an extension, CS will escalate. Keep thread updated with canary results. :thumbsup:
